bugs_and_engine_observations.title: Batch Squareoff Concurrency Drop under Rapid Multi-Order Close
bugs_and_engine_observations.description: When Master triggers bulk squareoff across 10 rapid positions, the server-side fanout queue fails to complete squareoff across all 50 follower copies within 35s, leaving residual open orders on follower ctf1.
bugs_and_engine_observations.reproduction: Place 10 orders (5 BUY, 5 SELL) on Master. Verify 50 copies on 5 followers. Loop-call squareoff_position on all 10 master orders with 0.1s delay. Query /book/orders.php on ctf1 after 35s.

bugs_and_engine_observations.title: Unfollowed Follower with Open Position Closes Erroneously on Master Squareoff
bugs_and_engine_observations.description: When a follower calls follow.php?type=unfollow while holding an active position, the existing position is maintained. However, when the Master subsequently squares off, the unfollowed follower's position is still closed.
bugs_and_engine_observations.reproduction: Follower follows Master. Master opens position. Follower un-follows. Master squares off position. Follower position closes unexpectedly.

bugs_and_engine_observations.title: Stop HFT BOTH Placement Requires bs='buy' Parameter
bugs_and_engine_observations.description: Calling /trade/placeorder.php?type=stop&stop_hft_type=2 with bs=both returns {'status': 'fail', 'message': 'Invalid order side'}. The server requires bs=buy to instantiate both legs ('orderId': '58777,58778').

bugs_and_engine_observations.title: Execution Price Markup / Slippage of ~5.5 Points
bugs_and_engine_observations.description: Follower executions consistently execute with a fixed spread/markup of 5.4 - 5.6 points relative to the master fill price on X:BTCUSD.
bugs_and_engine_observations.reproduction: Compare master avg fill price vs follower avg fill price on identical order placement.
